claims.text: 33B Dense overall 61.69 (JA 62.18 / EN 59.72) vs base llm-jp-4-33b-thinking 51.50 (+10.19), vs llm-jp-4.1 60.64, vs Qwen3-32B 58.11; trails Qwen3.5-27B 68.18 / Gemma 4 31B 70.54. 32B-A3B MoE overall 58.46 (JA 59.61 / EN 55.94) vs base 46.38 (+12.08); trails Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 66.37 / Gemma 4 26B-A4B 68.58.
claims.context: Pinned card Benchmark Results tables read in full (dense + MoE tables above).

claims.text: Japanese deltas: M-IFEval-ja 85.84 vs 67.48 (33B), 81.75 vs 63.05 (MoE); Nejumi BFCL-ja 46.53 vs 11.58, 41.89 vs 11.58; JHumanEval 95.73/95.37; JMMLU 84.69/81.05; LiveCodeBench 60.23 vs 35.60, 53.66 vs 26.86; BFCL-v4 38.73 vs 12.45, 36.31 vs 13.29.

Method: JA-localized mid-training (math/coding/STEM + agentic, tool calls/JSON intact) + program-verified SFT (several million, ~half JA, teacher + checkers, furigana/kanji-numeral constraints, Wiki/Wikidata JA knowledge) + RLVR (verifiable problems, program rewards, loopholes closed). Conditions: temp 0.6/top_p 0.95; parallel-call exclusion (BFCL floor 10.00/11.58); effort high for llm-jp, thinking-on for ELYZA; max output native−4096.
